scope: Exact five-module retained Home Assistant model-presentation and safe local input-budget failure correction; source installation only.

findings.detail: ConversationActionReceipt.output and original durable proof/events remain the source. Optional model_output is a host presentation, used by the model adapter and excluded from receipt equality. The adapter validates raw receipt/proof/observation hashes, original response and truncation metadata, and a smaller exact projection.

Capture and each local reader revalidate the original verified action thread, actor/message scope, ingress digest, execution namespace, call/step, complete timeline, and proof/receipt hashes. Current authorization and stop checks remain. Missing, changed or incomplete sources are refused.

Large verified Home Assistant request/inventory receipts use the existing ConnectorResults manifest and bounded use_connector_tool reader. No Home Assistant invocation is repeated by capture or selection. Existing stored-result capability is required. A complete stored copy means the exact retained observation object, not a new external observation.

The 8192-byte presentation threshold does not increase the existing input, receipt, transport, grant or task budgets. Local _InputBudgetError produces the existing budget_exceeded outcome, safe fixed input_budget_exceeded failure report, unchanged fingerprint and measured usage; no successful result or retry is invented.

validation.executionHistory: Initial invocation: 9 passed and 1 test-assertion failure. Only the affected assertion was corrected from tuple to list, then that node passed. Failed output is retained; no source changes between invocations.
validation.evidenceVerification: All five source and two changed test hashes, patch, invocation receipts, logs and JUnit files matched; JUnit outcomes corroborate ten unique passed nodes.
validation.coverage: Synthetic retained source/replay and actual local reader interface, scope/source/stop/hash rejection, existing capture behavior and pre-provider input-budget refusal.

limitations: No installation or live task resume was evaluated by this source review.
Future full-request fit, native completion, migration success and behavioral quality remain unproved.
Original failed tasks, partial/unknown usage and raw proof bytes remain historical evidence.
Synthetic timeline tests do not establish production Postgres transaction behavior or a new external read.
